reference: E. C. Titchmarsh, The Theory of the Riemann Zeta-Function, 2nd ed., revised D. R. Heath-Brown (1986), section 10.25, pp. 282-285
statement: The same mod-5 DH function has infinitely many zeros with Re(s)>1.
